how.title: How Sagi Shield Works
how.subtitle: How we provide real-time protection while preserving complete privacy
how.step1_desc: When your browser supports on-device recognition, speech becomes text on your phone or tablet and the audio never leaves it. Without it, Live Guard asks before using cloud recognition.
how.step2_desc: Identifies official authority impersonation, coercion, and secret account demands in real-time.
how.step3_desc: Triggers a full-screen alert and loud voice prompt ('Hang up the phone!') before money can be wired.
how.privacy_desc: Sagi Shield never records or stores calls. Speech is turned into text on your device; only text with numbers hidden reaches our server, where AI checks it and discards it. Cloud speech recognition is used only if you turn it on. To keep bots out, the app has Google reCAPTCHA check the browser (no call content is involved).
how.privacy_badge_3: Family alerted only upon high danger

deepfake.title: Watch out for deepfake video calls
deepfake.intro: Scammers use AI to copy the face and voice of a relative or friend in a video call, then ask for money urgently. Seeing a familiar face does not prove who is calling.
signs: The call is very short - a few seconds.
The face shows little emotion; posture and movement look awkward.
Odd skin tone or lighting; the picture looks artificial.
Sound does not match the picture, lots of noise, or no sound at all.
They hang up midway, blaming a weak signal.
deepfake.action: Stay calm, hang up and call back on the number you already have saved. Never send money because of a video call alone.
deepfake.source: Based on the five warning signs published by Vietnam's Authority of Information Security. Sagi Shield does not analyze video calls yet.
